about: Magnitude response of each FM9 firmware-12 factory cab, in tenths of a dB relative to its own mean, at 'frequencies'. Measured on an FM9 (2026-10-13) with pink noise through the Cab block alone. The FM3 (13.00) and Axe-Fx III (32.06) list the same cabs under the same names in the same order (the Axe-Fx III's Legacy bank, its bank 4, adds ten more), so the curves are taken to hold there too.
